stem: Find the value of $\binom{{=n}}{1}+\binom{{=n}}{3}+\binom{{=n}}{5}+\dots$, the sum of the combinations with odd lower index, by substituting $x=1$ and $x=-1$ in $(1+x)^{{=n}}$.
solution: Put $x=1$: $2^{{=n}}=E+O$, where $E$ is the sum of the even-index terms and $O$ the sum of the odd-index terms.
notes: Standard: two substitutions, x=1 and x=-1.
